test(doctor): the effect-refresh e2e clicks each doctor run after the one before it has reported

A click replaces the session's run still on its way, which is then never
read, so two clicks a draw apart logged one run or two depending on how soon
the first reading landed, which a loaded runner decides; the test then waited
for four logged runs that never came.

fix(host): a process's world drops the variables that locate a repository, so a daemon started from a GIT_DIR shell reads each session's own repo (99f8)

The detached daemon inherits the environment of whichever shell spawned it.
GIT_DIR, GIT_WORK_TREE, the rest of `git rev-parse --local-env-vars` and
GH_REPO in that shell pointed every session's git and forge reads at the
wrong repository, and `cc-candybar doctor` run there drew the same wrong bar.

The world is now built by removing those names from the process's own
environment before anything launches, so every child (git, gh, the renderer,
a plugin clone) inherits the drop. git names the variables; a fixed list
stands in when it cannot (the ask fails, names nothing, or an old git echoes
the flag back), and that fallback is loud: a daemon log warning, a standing
warning on the bar, and a failing `environment` doctor row with the reason.
Processes that stand in for a session (the Node client, check, doctor, the
site) report the dropped values back as the session's own environment.
plugin install's local overlay of the same variables is removed, since the
world now owns the drop.
fix(daemon): a failure too big to send is drawn in its lane's shape and recorded as the client got it, and a refusal ends the phase with the socket (df7i)
fix(daemon): every move of a connection is one transition of its phase, and a frame past the cap is pushed as RENDER_FAILED on a stream that goes on (df7i)
fix(daemon): a connection is one state, reads one frame, and answers an unencodable reply (df7i)

chore(release): set `package.json` to 1.232.10

## [1.232.10](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/compare/v1.232.9...v1.232.10) (2026-11-18)

### Bug Fixes

* **daemon:** a daemon's exit leaves the socket lease, so a displaced daemon can no longer unlink a newer daemon's lease (m5bq) ([#832](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/issues/832)) ([cd50aea](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/commit/cd50aea5c94fd0ade68b7e1781ec29d6b93ca2e0))

fix(edit): a placement's session state is owned by the chain that placed it, and every load releases what that chain ended

Several configs can place one preset and id, and a placement ends only
between two loads of the files that placed it. So each placement-owned key
(drafts, the configure list, the + libraries and their page cursors, and
the configure key's value) now names its owner: the ordered config files
whose merge placed it.

- src/config/placement-keys.ts mints and reads back every family, in its
  owner-free and owned forms. Each read is checked by re-minting.
- The compile stays shared and names keys owner-free. The owner is added
  at one seam (src/renderer/owned-store.ts), built once per render state
  and once per click.
- Every load that does not fail measures each prefix of its chain before
  unplaced cells are dropped. Across every session in the store, it
  releases each key whose owner is one of its prefixes and whose placement
  that prefix no longer holds, and every family key naming no owner. A
  failed load releases nothing. Author menu keys and keys of other owners
  are left alone. Each release logs its session, owner, chain and keys.
- A layout click releases the clicker's ended keys through the click's
  journal, so its undo restores the drafts.
- The raw session store refuses an owner-free family key on get, set and
  setBatch.
- Navigation steps record the owner they were made under, so going back
  in one config never replays a step over another config's keys.
